Name: Titus
Role: Fellow worker and messenger to Corinth
Summary: Titus was Paul's fellow worker who carried letters to Corinth, reported the church's repentance, and was later left by Paul in Crete to set in order the things that were wanting and ordain elders.
KeyStory: Titus was Paul's fellow worker who carried letters to Corinth, reported the church's repentance, and was later left by Paul in Crete to set in order the things that were wanting and ordain elders.
KeyVerses: 2 Corinthians 2:13; 2 Corinthians 7:6; 2 Corinthians 8:23; Galatians 2:1; 2 Timothy 4:10; Titus 1:4
LifeLesson: A trusted messenger who brings both hard words and comfort is a gift to the church.
